verses.1: A song for the Day of Rest.
verses.2: It is good to worship Yahweh and to sing His name.
verses.3: To declare in the morning your kindness and truthfulness on those nights.
verses.4: Above the twenty, and above the seven; above the Haggion in the chest.
verses.5: For Jehovah has gladly done what You commanded Him in Your deeds.
verses.6: How great are your deeds, O LORD! Your thoughts are profound indeed.
verses.7: A fool will not understand this, and a stupid person will not comprehend it at all.
verses.8: In the time of wickedness, like weeds that sprout up everywhere, all kinds of weeds will grow up to cover them.
verses.9: And you will be praised forever, O LORD.
verses.10: For behold, your enemies will be destroyed by the Lord. All those who do evil will be scattered and left alone.
verses.11: And they offered sacrifices in my nostrils, with fragrant oils.
verses.12: And my eyes were blinded by the flames that rose up before me. I heard the sounds of evil forces approaching.
verses.13: The righteous will bloom like roses in the valley of light.
verses.14: Let them flourish in the house of Jehovah, in the courtyards of our God.
verses.15: They will still be in exile for many years, and they will continue to suffer.
verses.16: To say that Jehovah is righteous, and that He does not err.
